Indian chess is already blessed with many strong 2700+ players - Pragg, Arjun, Gukesh, Nihal. The question on everyone's mind is - who is the next player who will hit 2700? Well, it seems we have an answer to this question now. Pranav V. playing on the top board of his team Elektroprivedra was up against Anish Giri from Bayegan Pendik Chess Club at the European Club Cup 2026. Check out this game and the insane level at which Pranav played. Definitely 2700 Elo coming soon!
ChessBase India has built this new website - where students can find their ideal coach. Do check it out!
